description:
**Dimension: test-conventions · 13 findings (10 medium, 3 low)** — see report §test-conventions (the high SimulationRunner item is filed separately).

Medium:
- `gf2-core/src/field/axiom_tests.rs:1027` — bare `#[ignore]` → `#[ignore = "slow: gf2m_wide_256 axiom stress"]`.
- `gf2-kernels-hip/tests/throughput_bench.rs:13` — rename `bench_gpu_vs_cpu_batch64`→`test_gpu_cpu_batch64_throughput` + add `#[ignore="slow: ..."]`.
- `gf2-coding/` 9 test files — 20+ bare `#[ignore]` → tagged `slow:`/`external:`; convert `bcjr/mod.rs:968` inline `// ~38s:` comment to a reason string.
- `gf2-coding/tests/ldpc_cache_io.rs` — six `"Slow:"` → lowercase `"slow:"`.
- `gf2-coding/src/bch/core.rs` — add `mod proptests`: encode/decode roundtrip with <= t errors + syndrome-zero for valid codewords.
- `gf2-sim/src/bin/dvb_t2_awgn_campaign.rs` — 18 `#[test]` fns lack `test_` prefix; rename.
- `gf2-kernels-simd/` 9 kernel files — ~14 `#[test]` fns lack `test_` prefix; rename.
- `gf2-kernels-hip/tests/gpu_cpu_crosscheck.rs:272` — two proptest GPU tests need `#[ignore="external: gfx1030 device required"]` + `#[cfg(feature="hip")]`.
- `gf2-kernels-hip/src/lib.rs:1227` — three in-module GPU tests + `test_demap_on_stream...` need `#[ignore="external: ..."]`.
- `gf2-core/src/bitvec.rs` — add `proptest!` for: tail-bits-zero after mutation, double-inverse, shift roundtrip, push/pop roundtrip, polar_transform self-inverse.

Low:
- `gf2-core/src/bitvec.rs:1705` — `test_new/zeros/ones/clear` (+ gfpn quadratic/cubic) lack `_<scenario>` suffix.
- `gf2-algebra/src/packed/{packed5,packed7}.rs` — add direct algebraic-invariant proptests (commutativity/distributivity/neg-involution).
- `gf2-kernels-simd/` 7 kernel modules — add proptest field-axiom + SIMD-vs-scalar suites (pattern in bipedal3.rs:623-680).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: All bare/mis-cased `#[ignore]` annotations carry a lowercase tagged reason string (`slow:`/`sim:`/`external:`).
- [hard] REQ-02: All `#[test]` fns named `test_<operation>_<scenario>`.
- [hard] REQ-03: New proptest coverage added for BCH, BitVec invariants, and the packed/kernel modules listed; slow variants `#[ignore]`.
- [hard] REQ-04: Fast tier (`cargo nextest --profile ci`) stays within the 60 s / 5 s-per-test budget; clippy + fmt pass.
title: Fix test-convention violations and add missing proptest coverage
